script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

Coach KELLY (50s, fiery) paces the basketball court, watching as his TEAM struggles in a scrimmage. JASON (17, introverted) stands on the sidelines, staring at the floor.

COACH KELLY
(shouting)
Jason! Get in the game!

Jason reluctantly steps onto the court, looking around at his teammates with a mix of fear and determination. The ball is passed to him, and he hesitates before making a move.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CLASSROOM - LATER

Jason sits in the back of the room, doodling in a notebook. The TEACHER, MS. PARKER (30s, kind), approaches him with a concerned expression.

MS. PARKER
(softly)
Jason, are you okay? You've seemed off lately.

Jason looks up, surprised.

JASON
I just... I don't feel like I belong here.

MS. PARKER
(smiling)
Everyone feels that way sometimes. But you have a gift, Jason. A gift for basketball. Don't let that go to waste.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

Jason practices alone, shooting hoops and perfecting his moves. He hears footsteps approaching and looks up to see Coach Kelly watching him.

COACH KELLY
(impressed)
You've got something there, Jason. A fire in you that the others don't have.

Jason looks at him, unsure.

JASON
But what good is it if I can't help my team win?

COACH KELLY
(firmly)
You will, Jason. Trust me.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

Jason sits alone at a table, surrounded by his teammates and their loud chatter. He looks up as they approach him, looking curious.

TEAMMATE 1
(jokingly)
Hey Jason, what's that look for? You gonna join us or what?

Jason hesitates, then smiles and joins them at the table.

INT. SMALL-TOWN GYM - NIGHT

Jason and his teammates face off against a rival team in a tense basketball game. The crowd roars as Jason makes an incredible play, stealing the ball and scoring the winning point.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CLASSROOM - DAY

Ms. Parker watches as Jason receives an award for his sports achievements, surrounded by his proud teammates and Coach Kelly.

MS. PARKER
(smiling)
I'm so proud of you, Jason. You've come a long way.

Jason looks up at her, a proud smile on his face.

JASON
I couldn't have done it without all of you.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The team gathers for a final practice before the championship game. Jason stands in the center, surrounded by his teammates, looking determined.

COACH KELLY
(excitedly)
We've got this, team. We're going all the way to the championship.

Jason looks at each of his teammates, feeling a sense of camaraderie and belonging. Together, they take the court, ready to give it their all.

FADE OUT.
